name: glass-segmented
summary: A glass segmented control whose thumb stretches toward the new segment like a drop.
props: Equal-width segments; icon is a node shown before the label.
Controlled selection (or use defaultValue). Fires on tap and on release after a drag.
Force light or dark glass and ink, e.g. over a photo.
Selection colour: fills the thumb; the label switches to black or white to stay readable.
Selection tick on change and while dragging across segments.
Label for the whole control (tablist; each segment is a tab with selected state).
behavior: Tap a segment, or press the thumb and drag it across. It follows your finger and snaps to the nearest segment on release.
The thumb springs to the new segment, stretching in the direction of travel before it settles. It lifts slightly while you drag it.
The thumb slides over in a short timing with no stretch, and does not lift when dragged.
A selection tick on change and each time a drag crosses into another segment.
The control is a tablist and each segment a tab with its label and selected state.
Built on Glass: real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, blurred or frosted glass elsewhere.
